text.title: Checkout outage, 14 March 2026: 52 min, 1 140 orders lost
text.problem: Checkout returned errors for 52 min on 14 March (18:10–19:02); 1 140 orders were not paid
text.why_1: The payment service stopped answering after a spike in timeouts
text.why_2: Retries had no limit, so the request queue filled up in 9 minutes
text.why_3: A config change raised the payment timeout from 2 s to 30 s
text.why_4: The change went live without a load test, as a "minor" edit
text.why_5: Nothing defines which settings are risky, so "minor" is judged by the author
text.root_cause: Config changes of payment settings skip load-test review; there is no list of risky settings
text.countermeasure: Every payment setting needs review and a load test. Owner: Platform lead, by 1 April
text.check: No checkout error rate above 1% for 4 weeks after the change; reported weekly
